configure_keypoint_rcnn_fpn_model: configure a Keypoint R-CNN FPN model by extending mask_rcnn_fpn with keypoint detection heads
set_keypoint_pooler_roi_align: set the keypoint pooler using ROIAlignV2 with output size 14 and multi-scale FPN features
configure_krcnn_conv_deconv_head: configure the KRCNNConvDeconvUpsampleHead with 17 keypoints and 8 convolution layers of 512 channels
adjust_proposal_generator_nms: adjust the proposal generator post-NMS topk to 1500 training and 1000 inference proposals per image
set_smooth_l1_beta: set the box predictor smooth L1 beta to 0.5 to improve keypoint AP without degrading box AP
